economy.summary: His campaign prioritizes restoring passenger train service between Reading and Philadelphia, which he says would take thousands of cars off highways and revitalize boroughs and boost local economies.
economy.short: Prioritizes restoring passenger rail to revitalize boroughs, boost local economies.

taxes.summary: Supports property tax relief through fair education funding and educational mandate reform, and backs a natural gas severance tax and closing corporate tax loopholes as revenue sources.
taxes.short: Supports property tax relief, severance tax, closing corporate loopholes.

education.summary: Advocates for increased state funding of school districts, citing over $1 billion in added basic education funding across two budget cycles.
education.short: Advocates increased state funding for school districts.

healthcare.summary: Says no Pennsylvanian should have to choose between their health and their paycheck; voted to make prescription drugs more affordable and wrote a bill easing access to prescriptions.
healthcare.short: Voted to lower prescription costs; wrote prescription-access bill.

abortion.summary: Stated he supports a woman's right to choose and voted against abortion-restriction measures, including a 2022 proposed constitutional amendment (SB 106), as compiled by the advocacy tracker Choice Tracker.
abortion.short: Stated supports right to choose; voted against restrictions.

guns.summary: Co-sponsored House Bill 777 (2023-2024 session), which would require serial numbers on privately made firearms to address untraceable 'ghost guns'; the bill passed the House 104-97 in March 2024.
guns.short: Co-sponsored a bill requiring serial numbers on ghost guns.
